direction: FIX-3 (review4.docx §3.5): test prior robustness of T39
robustness_verdict: PRIOR-DEPENDENT: Tier-3 resolution DEPENDS on the prior choice. WIDE prior (allows SM-decoupling) gives log Z = -2.65 (resolved). NARROW prior (no SM-decoupling) gives log Z = -9387.60 (NOT resolved). Honest finding: 'Tier-3 resolution requires a prior that includes the SM-decoupled regime. The Roberts et al. 2024 default epsilon ~ 10^-4 falls in the narrow regime and is incompatible with LZ data.'
